scope: Retention-time coordinates supplied to the MS2 workflow
claim_boundary: Describes chromatographic context only and never changes the MS2 identity diagnostic

statuses.supplied_double_peak: Both Peak1 and Peak2 retention times are present
statuses.supplied_single_peak: Exactly one retention time is present

IG.meaning: Laboratory machine/run identifier with multiple pools; it is not a universal QC field

labels.GREEN: IG-source expectation of a usable double peak
labels.YELLOW: IG-source expectation of a usable single peak
labels.RED: No peak or multiple peaks; chromatographic result is unusable and is not a no-peak truth label

source_machine_label_context.IA_IB_and_other_sources: Store their raw source-machine labels separately. Do not infer that their colour vocabulary matches IG until confirmed.

automation.chromatographic_resolution_definition: Rs=1.17741*delta_rt/(FWHM1+FWHM2); factor-2 form is reserved for baseline widths

non_gating_rule: MS1 automatic labels and thresholds are not used to pass or fail the MS2 same-compound diagnostic
